issue_context.summary: The proposal bundles performance-band consolidation, battery presentation, and dock work-area behavior into one issue with independently owned acceptance criteria.
known_information: The request combines CPU, memory, network, and GPU into one flyout.
It separately asks for a battery charging indication.
It also reports application windows sliding under or overlapping the dock without a focused reproduction.
inferences: The three areas can be prioritized and implemented independently and likely involve different data, UI, and work-area ownership.
issue_context.analysis: The existing artifact's blanket duplicate classification was too broad because #48934 covers only network display. The actionable maintainer step is to decompose the bundle, not approve one speculative design or close every request as duplicate.
initial_investigation: Reviewed #48934 and confirmed it remains open for Performance Monitor network send/receive.
Reviewed #46477 and confirmed it is closed as duplicate and concerns compact dock sizing.
No implementation assignee or linked fix is present on #50224.

actions.label: Post issue-splitting direction

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed proposal. This combines three independently scoped changes: consolidating the performance bands, improving battery charging presentation, and correcting window/dock work-area overlap. Network send/receive is already tracked in #48934, so please continue that part there. The monitor consolidation, charging indicator, and reproducible dock-overlap behavior should be tracked separately with their own acceptance criteria, since they can be designed and delivered independently.
